title: A Quake on the Sun Had 40,000 Times 1906 San Francisco's Energy

scenes.text: The Sun once shook with a magnitude eleven quake.
In July 1996, a solar flare sent giant ripples across its surface.
They spread for a distance equal to ten Earths.
Their speed climbed from twenty-two thousand to two hundred fifty thousand miles an hour.
The energy matched forty thousand times the 1906 San Francisco earthquake.
A magnitude eleven quake. On the Sun.

description:
The Sun once shook with a magnitude eleven quake.
In July 1996, a solar flare sent ripples across the Sun's surface for a distance equal to ten Earths, with energy equal to about 40,000 times the 1906 San Francisco earthquake.
What do you think a sunquake would sound like?
